messages.subject: Error in chromosome 1
parts:
Hello again Yuchao,

Being getting this error only in chromosome 1:

After taking union, excluded 10358 out of 229611 exons in QC.
Error in smooth.spline(gc_qc, z) : 
  'tol' must be strictly positive and finite
Calls: normalize_null -> normalize -> apply -> FUN -> smooth.spline
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In matrix(nrow = nrow(Y_qc), ncol = ncol(Y_qc), data = N, byrow = TRUE) :
  data length exceeds size of matrix
2: In matrix(nrow = nrow(Y_qc), ncol = ncol(Y_qc), data = N, byrow = TRUE) :
  data length exceeds size of matrix
Execution halted

I didn't loose all my data after QC, so I was wandering what might be happening. Do you have any suggestions?

Thanks for your patience,
Ramon
